name: zvideo_dd_blt_primary_to_sw_rect_direct
description: zVideo_dd::BltPrimaryToSwRectDirect blits from the primary DirectDraw surface to the software surface with DDBLT_WAIT and reports DirectDraw failures.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw display/mode-management source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a7dd0 validates fastcall ECX=srcRect, EDX=dstRect, g_zVideo_SwSurfaceState.surf as the destination surface, g_zVideo_PrimarySurfaceState.surf as the source surface, DDBLT_WAIT, null DDBLTFX, and zVideo_dd::ReportError(hresult, zvid_dd.c, 0xfc) on nonzero DirectDraw result.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a7dd0 has no warnings and matches the implemented DirectDraw provider call and error-report branch.

The native smoke verifies the software-surface Blt provider call receives the supplied destination and source rectangles, the primary surface source pointer, DDBLT_WAIT, and null DDBLTFX. The bind-dispatch smoke verifies g_zVideo_pfnBltPrimaryToSwRectDirect is installed from the authored symbol.
